text:
alex: Heads-up: scheduled kernel+driver+fw roll tonight for us-west-2 GPU pool (driver 540.2 -> 545.0, fwk 2.3.1 -> 2.5). Want quick QA checklist and rollback gates. Tentative 23:00 PT.

marta: thanks. propose short smoke: 1) canary set (10% nodes) with perf tether 2) run 15m stress per node (mem + infer) 3) monitor XID/ECC + dmesg OOMs 4) verify latency p50/p95 not regressed

alex: canary /where/ ? same as last time (uc2-usw2-gpu-pool-canary)?

ryan: yep use uc2-usw2-canary-3..5. I'll start the canary job and attach smoke harness. Command for memtest: `gpu-burn -t 900 -m` and for inference: `ab -n 200 -c 5 http://canary.local/generate`

marta: alerts to watch: `gpu.xid.rate` per-gpu, `gpu.ecc.corrected.rate`, `node.reboots` and `serving.latency.p95`. SRE bot set thresholds: xid > baseline*4 in 10m -> page.

sre-bot: automation: monitoring rule created: if xid_count_per_gpu / baseline > 4 over 10m -> PAGER (pagerduty:sre-oncall). Also added temporary dashboard 'rollout/2051234567' with histograms.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: what's rollback criteria? full rollback on canary if any of: a) xid spike > 5x baseline in 15m b) more than 2 nodes with corrected ECC > 100 in 1h c) p95 latency +20%.

alex: Agree. Add a safety drain: if node shows persistent Xid > 1/hr for 2 consecutive hours, mark GPU as flaky and drain. Also allow single-host hotfix (reboot) before full rollback.

ryan: I'll run pre/post dmesg snapshot: `dmesg --time-format iso > /tmp/dmesg.pre` and after `dmesg --new > /tmp/dmesg.post` and grep for 'Xid' 'ECC' 'GPU'

marta: Also check kernel taints: `cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted` and driver logs `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log` (or `/var/log/driver-upgrade.log` for other vendors).

alex: Rolling canary now (deploy 23:05 PT). I'll post results in ~30m.

ryan: Smoke harness started 23:10 PT on 4 canary nodes. stress running.

sre-bot: 23:25 PT: Canary metrics summary: xid_rate aggregated up 0.8 -> 0.85 per GPU/hr (baseline 0.78), p95 latency +3%. No pagers.

ops-oncall: Quick check logs: one node uc2-canary-4 shows series of corrected ECC increments (counts: 20 -> 170 over 25m). I'm draining GPU 1 on that node.

marta: Drain path ok. If ECC corrected count rate > 5/min persist, mark for replacement. Record GPU id & serial.

alex: Canary looks mostly green aside from that ECC spike. Holding rolling. Ryan, collect `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` output and attach.

ryan: attached snippet:
```
GPU 1 Serial: GTX-ABCD1234
ECC errors (corrected): 170
Current temp: 72C
```
Not sure if temp-related.

ops-oncall: Node temps are fine. Could be aging card. Let's mark that GPU as suspect and exclude from rollout. Continue rollout to remaining canary nodes after exclusion.

sre-bot: Action taken: uc2-canary-4.gpu1 excluded from pool. Dashboard updated.

alex: Proceeding with limited roll to 50% after canary pass. Keep strict watch. If we hit Xid spike threshold, immediate rollback.

marta: Postmortem checklist: preserve logs, collect kernel and driver versions, uptime, and workload traces. Create follow-up ticket for replacement if ECC > 100 in <1h.

ops-oncall: Noted. I'll open ticket infra/GPU-REPLACE-2051234567 with serial and host.

ryan: All green so far on remaining canaries. Proceed when ready.

alex: Thanks team. I'll update the rollout doc and close thread when finished. :rocket:
